title: Optional 5.0-second Blitz Turn Timer integrated diegetically into the outer frame of the Ninefold Matrix (pulsing faster during the final 2 seconds and awarding speed-placement score bonuses).
author_role: Lead Gameplay & Kinematics Specialist (State machines, physics integration, collision rules)
summary: Run a 5.0-second diegetic Blitz Turn Timer rendered along the outer lattice border that pulses rapidly under 2.0s and computes speed bonuses on placement.
technical_specification: Initialize `state.world.blitz = { enabled: true, maxTime: 5.0, timeLeft: 5.0, lastTick: 0 }`. In active contender turns, decrement `timeLeft` by delta time `dt`. Trace the outer 360x360 border stroke using `(timeLeft / maxTime) * 1440px` perimeter line dash offset. When `timeLeft <= 2.0`, oscillate border line-width between 2px and 6px at frequency `f = 6Hz * (2.0 - timeLeft + 0.5)`. If `timeLeft <= 0`, force a forfeited turn with random vacant sector inscription. On player placement with `timeLeft > 0`, calculate speed bonus `Math.floor((timeLeft / 5.0) * 300) * state.stats.multiplier` and reset `timeLeft = 5.0`.
acceptance_criteria: The outer matrix border perimeter shrinks smoothly over 5 seconds and pulses in frequency/width during the final 2 seconds.
Placing a sigil within the window grants proportional speed bonus points; timer expiration auto-commits a random vacant sector.
